protocol.amendments: a rule change is appended as a PROTOCOL_AMENDMENT entry and applies only to freezes made after it; nothing already frozen is re-scored under new rules

freeze.entry_price: the line and price the community mirror carried in the frozen snapshot (evidence class C: not an official figure and not a verified executable quote)
freeze.kickoff_guard: uses the mirror's gameday/gametime (US Eastern); the official kickoff is checked on NFL.com afterwards and an entry found to post-date it is void
freeze.line_source: pipeline/models.originate_future on the named upstream snapshot, unmodified
freeze.no_backfill: a game that was not frozen in time never enters the forward record
freeze.pick_source: pipeline/strategies.build_library, unmodified, applied to the frozen slate
freeze.scope: next slate only: an unplayed game is eligible when neither team has an earlier unplayed game in the snapshot, so every rating and rest input is current

gates.F1_commitment: the pick is in a hash-chained freeze entry that reached GitHub before the official kickoff
gates.F2_official_settlement: the final score was confirmed on NFL.com
gates.F3_sample: at least 150 counted single-game picks (60 tickets for a parlay strategy) over at least 30 distinct weeks; no verdict of any kind before that
gates.F4_skill: mean closing-line value above zero, one-sided week-block bootstrap, Holm-adjusted p <= 0.05 across every registered strategy
gates.F5_economics: forward return at frozen prices above zero and still above zero after the canonical five-cent adverse price stress
gates.F6_quote_provenance: prices come from a verifiable, timestamped sportsbook quote; the community mirror does not satisfy this, so F6 fails for every strategy until such a feed exists

grading.closing_line_value: spread/total: points the mirror's closing number moved toward the pick; moneyline: change in de-vigged probability of the picked side
grading.provisional: a mirror score that has not been checked on NFL.com grades as PROVISIONAL and is excluded from every forward statistic
grading.result_source: final score read on NFL.com and recorded with its URL (class A)
grading.settlement: pipeline/backtest.settle_row at the frozen line and price; push refunds; parlay push reduces the ticket (same rule as the canonical backtest)

protocol.reward: recognition only, and only when F1-F6 all pass at the F3 horizon; no interim winners; there is no funded prize pool
protocol.trial_registry: a strategy is scored forward only from the first freeze entry that lists it; the registered set is the complete list of forward trials

body.text: Status of this ledger: evidence capture only. The sample horizon (F3), the skill and economics tests (F4, F5), the quote requirement (F6) and the reward rule in the genesis entry are defaults proposed by the session that created the ledger. The repository owner has not approved them. They correspond to items that are still open on the main site: 'Pre-register the next library and freeze it' (suggestion S12), 'Prospective paper competition' (suggestion S05, proposed, not approved), 'What must a strategy show before it is eligible for any reward?' (question Q25, needs decision) and 'How long must a prospective replication run before a verdict?' (question Q26, needs decision). Until the owner records a decision on those items in this ledger as an OWNER_DECISION entry: (1) no verdict and no reward of any kind is issued for any strategy, whatever its sample size; (2) if the owner's rule and the genesis defaults differ, the stricter requirement applies to everything frozen before the decision. This amendment changes no frozen line, pick, price or settlement rule. It only removes the possibility of a verdict, so it also applies to entry 1.
